WEIGHT MANAGEMENT

Comprehensive program for weight management

A program to work on your eating habits and your relationship with weight, without extreme restrictions and at your own pace: an interactive experience with a PDF workbook, or a one-on-one online session.

  • Real habits

Choose how you want to start

Two options to work on your habits and your relationship with weight: an interactive experience to do at your own pace, or a live one-on-one conversation.

My Balance Map

An interactive experience in Spanish and English: explore six areas of your wellbeing, choose the cards that speak to you and build your own map. At the end it becomes a PDF workbook to write in by hand.

What's included

  • Six areas: calm, rest, body, boundaries, nature and enjoyment
  • 25 cards with questions and small actions to choose at your own pace
  • A PDF workbook (A4) with your map and space to write

Timing: PDF workbook to download on your device

USD 12.99

What's included

  • Specific questions answered live
  • Ideal if you prefer to talk before deciding
  • We coordinate a time that suits you

Timing: Booked via WhatsApp; payment is confirmed before the session
